summary.tldr: Changes Criminal Code sentencing rules by adding aggravating factors and requiring courts to consider why a person was detained before sentencing.
what_it_does: Adds an aggravating factor for certain offences when the crime involved an occupied place and the offender used violence or threats, or carried, used, or threatened to use a weapon or imitation weapon.

Adds an aggravating factor when an offence was committed against a person or property made vulnerable by long emergency response times or by being far from emergency services or an established community.
Requires courts, when giving credit for time spent in custody before sentencing, to consider the reason the person was detained.
who_it_affects: People convicted of certain Criminal Code offences
People held in custody before sentencing
summary.background: The bill amends the Criminal Code’s sentencing rules. It replaces section 348.1 and adds a new factor courts must consider at sentencing.
